item.text:
Added “Compact” next to “Priority only”. It toggles the main panel’s `compact` class and the button’s `is-active` highlight, with `aria-pressed` reflecting its state.

Kept changes to two files. Tests, typecheck, lint, build, and diff checks all passed.
